display_name: PAMF 信道伪标签分配：33 个冻结前缀的源域质量证伪
description: 普通 PL 保持阈值0.95和U权重1；原物理半批中同预测且信道置信度0.95的样本，将0.2 CE份额分配给原T1 As视图，原始CE保留0.8；其余精确退回原PL。只诊断全部源V，不训练、不测目标。
authorization: 2026-10-25 用户要求继续深入分析 REPL 的整体负收益并优化半监督；既有三GPU、三个seed授权。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Python/Torch2.1; FP32/TF32off; no installs

data.dataset: ManySig / ManyRx, eleven unchanged VALIDATED_ONCE source contracts
data.contract_ref: same-contract E20 complete.config.source_contract; private checked context
data.label_map_ref: existing default-head classes: six / ManyRx ten

roles.L_s: first two IQ for real-checkpoint smoke only
roles.U_s: not opened by diagnostic; truth always hidden
roles.V: complete source V, labels for precision diagnosis, zero updates

data.train_ratio: unchanged per existing contract; no new training
data.validation_ref: existing VALIDATED_ONCE handles, unchanged; Phase1 capsule/split p2 handles not applicable

permissions.claim_scope: Source-V pseudo-label precision proxy; not U truth correctness, target accuracy, significance or new blind generalization.

checkpoint.initialization: frozen same-contract ordinary-PL E20 scratch prefix; explicit PL was already active E14-E20
sources: 33 exact ordinary-PL E20 prefixes from original fixed matrices
checkpoint.selection_rule: all eleven fixed contracts x three seeds; no accuracy ranking, no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: physical5/6/7 map to seeds2026092701/02/03; <=2 own/card, <=3 total CUDA/pending/card including foreign; >=10000MiB free
execution.stop_rule: Any technical failure stops new admissions; already healthy children finish, outputs preserved. No retries or target-result stopping. Scientific fail is a completed negative diagnostic.

expected_artifacts: per-row actual-checkpoint L_s no-query smoke PASS
fixed scientific-rule verdicts and per RX/day/class source counts

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: source-only aggregate counts; no target prediction
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source_quality.scientific_rule; no independent target scorer needed for this no-target diagnostic
